enchantment.baileys_enchantments.execute: Deals 20% bonus damage and causes bleeding on every strike. Below 20% health, one hit Executes them instantly.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.obliter: +5.5 arrow damage. Arrows detonate on impact, harming nearby foes.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.overdri: Mines at incredible speed and shatters a 3x3 area as you dig.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.aegis.d: Each piece absorbs 22.5% of incoming damage (90% as a full set), but burdens you with crippling Slowness.
Grants the power of flight. You will never take fall damage.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.eternal: This item never breaks and is never lost on death.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.abundan: Drops as though mined with Fortune V, then doubled.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.retribu: Reflects all damage to attackers and afflicts them with Weakness and Slowness.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.shockwa: Strikes launch all nearby enemies away and slow them.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.tempest: Arrows summon lightning and hurl nearby enemies away.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.lightni: Melee hits call down a lightning bolt on the target.
Break the base log to fell the entire tree at once.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.multish: Fires three arrows for the cost of one.
Arrows curve in-flight toward the nearest enemy.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.shatter: +45 damage in the Deep Dark, and against anything born of it. Nothing at all elsewhere.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.silence: The deep stops hearing you. You emit no vibrations — sensors, shriekers and the Warden itself are blind to you, though it can still smell you.
Speed, attack speed and a chance to evade a hit outright. Scales with pieces worn.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.dissona: Mirage, sharpened. Sneak-click to phase: flash step, but you take far more damage.
enchantment.baileys_enchantments.resonan: Sonic pulse on hit, and Execute's perks. Right-click to gather and scatter at 20% health.
